direct.system:
Translate SCAN commands into action tokens.
walk = I_WALK; run = I_RUN; jump = I_JUMP; look = I_LOOK.
turn left = I_TURN_LEFT; turn right = I_TURN_RIGHT.
For an action left/right, turn once that direction then perform the action.
For an action opposite left/right, turn twice then perform the action once.
For an action around left/right, repeat (one turn then the action) four times.
turn opposite left/right means two turns. turn around left/right means four turns.
twice repeats the entire preceding clause twice; thrice repeats it three times.
A and B executes A then B. A after B executes B then A.
Return only the requested JSON. Do not explain.
direct.instruction: Translate the complete command. Apply all direction, modifier, repetition and execution-order rules. Return {"actions":[...]} only.

direct.system:
You translate SCAN language into an ordered list of action tokens. Apply these exact rules.
Primitive actions: walk -> I_WALK; run -> I_RUN; look -> I_LOOK; jump -> I_JUMP.
For direction left, T is I_TURN_LEFT. For direction right, T is I_TURN_RIGHT.
Let A be the primitive action token named in the clause. The exact clause patterns are:
action alone: [A]
action left/right: [T,A]
action opposite left/right: [T,T,A]
action around left/right: [T,A,T,A,T,A,T,A]
turn left/right: [T]
turn opposite left/right: [T,T]
turn around left/right: [T,T,T,T]
The word turn never emits a walk/run/look/jump token. Turns always precede their action.
twice means concatenate TWO copies of the WHOLE clause pattern. thrice means THREE copies. No repetition word means ONE copy. Repeat turns as well as actions; never repeat only the final token.
A and B: finish all of A, then all of B. A after B: finish all of B, then all of A. A clause's repetition stays attached to that clause when ordering changes.
Concatenate without merging, deleting, or cancelling adjacent identical turns. Stop when both clauses are complete.
Output only JSON with an actions array of quoted tokens. Do not emit shorthand, counts, ellipses, or explanations.
direct.instruction: Translate the final Command below. First determine clause execution order, then each complete clause pattern and its repeat count. Concatenate the finished patterns in that order. Check the number of tokens and stop at the exact end. Return only {"actions":[...]}. Examples, if present, are separate tasks.

plan.system: You extract a SCAN clause plan. Copy the command words; do not translate them into action tokens. Output only the specified JSON.
plan.instruction: Split the command at and or after into one or two clauses. For and, output left clause then right clause. For after, output RIGHT clause FIRST, then LEFT clause. Within each clause remove only a final twice/thrice and put its value 2/3 in repeat; otherwise repeat=1. Keep all remaining action/direction/around/opposite words in command. Do not remove direction or modifiers. Output {"steps":[{"command":"...","repeat":1}]}. Each input clause appears exactly once; repeats are numbers, not extra steps.

Command: look opposite right thrice and turn opposite right thrice
